about.description: SanRoc Cay Marina is a laid-back entertainment district featuring boutique shopping, fine dining restaurants, a full-service marina with deep sea fishing and water sports, spas and salons, and business offices, all centered around a courtyard gathering space with water views.
about.elevator_pitch: A waterfront entertainment hub in Orange Beach offering shopping, dining, marina services, and relaxation with free sunrises and sunsets.
about.vibe: Laid-back, upscale casual, waterfront setting with luxury boutiques and outdoor courtyard atmosphere
about.insider_tip: There's a sunrise and a sunset every single day, and they're absolutely free. Don't miss them.
